A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to conduct a public hearing and adopt Resolution No. 014­2024, ordering the
  levy and collection of assessments within the Hawaiian Gardens Consolidated Landscaping and
  Lighting Assessment District No. HGLLA1 for Fiscal Year 2024­2025.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, presented the staff report and introduced Sabina Haug.

  Sabina Haug, Willdan, spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 014­2024.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 4; Del Rio, Roa, Vargas, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 1; Farfan
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 4–0–1–0

  by title and further reading waived.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Roa, seconded by Councilmember Del Rio, to adopt

C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

1.  Recommendation to conduct second reading of Ordinance No. 2024­617, (1) amending Chapter
  6.47 (Urban Storm Runoff Control) to Title 6 (Health and Safety) of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal
  Code regarding urban storm run off; (2) amending Chapter 13.04 (Water System) to Title 13
  (Utilities) of the Hawaiian Gardens Municipal Code regarding water system; (3) amending Chapter
  13.20 (Low Impact Development Standards) to Title 13 (Utilities) of the Hawaiian Gardens
  Municipal Code regarding water system; and (4) finding the project exempt from CEQA pursuant to
  state CEQA guidelines.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  John Natalizio, City Attorney, spoke.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Del Rio, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Ordinance No. 2024­617.

  The motion was carried by the following vote:

  NOES: 0;
